goal: Freeze the product and repository ownership model.
description: Pafio owns project workflows, Styio owns compiler results, Platform owns hosted services, and Vityo consumes three separate machine sources.

acceptance_criteria.text: Owner repositories and public entry documents state the same product boundary.
Styio accepts compile plans generated by Pafio without owning package resolution.

description: Pin immutable repository revisions, run each full regression once, then run one cross-repository product matrix before public release.

acceptance_criteria.text: All affected repositories pass their single final full regression.
The fixed-revision ecosystem acceptance matrix passes without compatibility shims.
